raw:
APPLICATION TO WITHDRAW SUIT AND SEEK PERMISSION TO FILE FRESH SUIT

That the Plaintiff, being the rightful party to the present suit, hereby seeks to withdraw the suit in accordance with Section 1 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, which permits a plaintiff, at any time after the institution of a suit, to withdraw his suit or abandon part of his claim.

That the Plaintiff further seeks an order permitting the institution of a fresh suit on the same cause of action, pursuant to Section 4 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, which authorises a plaintiff, where a suit is dismissed, to either bring a fresh suit or apply for an order to set the dismissal aside, provided sufficient cause is shown.

That the Plaintiff submits that there exists sufficient cause for the withdrawal and for the filing of a fresh suit, and that no prejudice will be caused to the Defendant by the granting of the present application.

That the Plaintiff prays that this Hon’ble Court may be pleased to:

(a) Allow the withdrawal of the present suit; and  

(b) Grant permission to institute a fresh suit on the same cause of action, in accordance with the provisions of Section 4 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908.

RENT AGREEMENT  

This Rent Agreement is made on this ___ day of __________ 20__, between:  

**Landlord:** Bilal Hussain, residing at ______________________  

**Tenant:** Farah Naz, residing at ______________________  

**Premises:** A flat in Johar Town, Lahore, Punjab.  

**Term:** 11 months, commencing on ___ (date) and ending on ___ (date).  

**Monthly Rent:** Rs. 45,000 (Forty‑Five Thousand Rupees) payable in advance on or before the ___ day of each month.  

**Mode of Payment:** ______________________ (if not specified, payment shall be by money order as per Punjab Rented Premises Act 2009, Sec. 7(3)).  

**Bank Account Details of Landlord (if rent to be paid by bank):** ______________________  

**Security Deposit:** Rs. __________ (amount)  

**Purpose of Letting:** ______________________  

---

1. **Payment of Rent** – The Tenant shall pay or tender the rent to the Landlord in the mode and by the date mentioned above in accordance with Punjab Rented Premises Act 2009, Sec. 7.  

2. **Obligations of the Landlord** – The Landlord shall:  
   a) Provide a certified copy of this tenancy agreement to the Tenant (Punjab Rented Premises Act 2009, Sec. 12(1)(a));  
   b) Repair the premises as may be necessary to keep it in habitable condition, subject to this agreement (Punjab Rented Premises Act 2009, Sec. 12(1)(b)).  

3. **Default and Notice** – If the rent for any month is not paid, the Landlord may give notice to the Tenant as required under CPC 1908, Sec. 3.  

4. **Effect of Other Agreements** – Any agreement entered into between the parties after the execution of this tenancy agreement, relating to matters other than those provided for herein, shall not affect the landlord‑tenant relationship unless the tenancy is revoked through a written agreement entered before the Rent Registrar (Punjab Rented Premises Act 2009, Sec. 10).  

---

**Signed:**  

_____________________________  
Landlord (Bilal Hussain)  

_____________________________  
Tenant (Farah Naz)
